spec.title: Blocky
spec.description: Operational dashboard for the blocky DNS proxy and ad blocker: traffic, latency, blocking effectiveness, caching, DNSSEC, rate limiting and Go runtime health.

spec.title: Blocking
spec.description: Ad/tracker blocking status. Use the 'Blocking control' buttons below to enable or temporarily disable blocking via the blocky API.

spec.title: Query rate
spec.description: Current DNS queries per second across all selected instances.

spec.title: Blocked
spec.description: Share of queries answered as BLOCKED over the dashboard time range.

spec.title: p95 latency (all clients)
spec.description: 95th percentile of request duration (all response types).

spec.title: Cache hit ratio (all clients)
spec.description: Share of cacheable queries answered from the result cache.

spec.title: Errors (all clients)
spec.description: Queries that ended in an error over the dashboard time range.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since the (longest running) blocky process started.

spec.title: Denylist entries
spec.description: Total domains in all denylist groups (summed over instances).

spec.title: Last list refresh
spec.description: Age of the newest deny/allowlist refresh. Turns yellow after one day and red after three days without a refresh.

spec.title: Cache entries
spec.description: Entries currently in the DNS result cache (summed over instances).

spec.title: Failed list downloads
spec.description: Deny/allowlist download failures over the dashboard time range.

spec.title: Blocking control
spec.description: Enable or temporarily disable blocking via the blocky API ($blocky_url). Grafana shows a notification with the result; the 'Blocking' stat and the 'Blocking active' timeline reflect the change on the next refresh.

spec.title: Queries by outcome
spec.description: Top 10 response types by query rate at each time step for the selected clients. Requires blocky_client_response_total; err means no response was produced.

spec.title: Query rate by client (top 10)
spec.description: The ten busiest clients among the selected clients over time.

spec.title: Top 10 clients
spec.description: The ten clients with the most queries over the dashboard time range across the selected job and instance. Ignores the Traffic client selector.

spec.title: Query types
spec.description: DNS record types requested by the selected clients over the dashboard time range. Multiple selected clients are combined.

spec.title: Response codes (all clients)
spec.description: DNS response codes returned to clients (NOERROR, NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL, …). This metric has no client label, so the Traffic client selector does not apply.

spec.title: Response reasons
spec.description: Response types for the selected clients over the dashboard time range (CACHED, BLOCKED, RESOLVED, etc.). blocky_client_response_total does not expose detailed reasons, upstream resolvers, or denylist groups. err means no response was produced.

spec.title: Request duration percentiles (all clients)
spec.description: Median, 90th and 99th percentile of end-to-end request duration.

spec.title: Request duration heatmap (all clients)
spec.description: Distribution of request durations over time.

spec.title: p95 duration by outcome (all clients)
spec.description: p95 duration per response type — cached answers should be microseconds, RESOLVED reflects upstream latency.

spec.title: Blocking active
spec.description: History of the blocking switch — shows when blocking was temporarily disabled.

spec.title: Blocked queries
spec.description: Rate of blocked queries (left axis) and blocked share of all queries (right axis).

spec.title: Top block reasons (all clients)
spec.description: Which denylist groups blocked the most queries in the dashboard time range. The `reason` metric label is intentionally group-level to keep its cardinality bounded; for the specific matched rule/domain, use the query-log dashboard.

spec.title: Failed list downloads
spec.description: List download failures over time — investigate sustained failures (lists go stale).

spec.title: Cache size
spec.description: Entries in the result cache and number of domains tracked as prefetch candidates.

spec.title: Prefetch activity
spec.description: Domains refreshed ahead of expiry and answers served from prefetched entries.

spec.title: Redis buffer drops
spec.description: Cache writes dropped because the Redis write-through buffer was full. Only relevant with Redis enabled; non-zero values mean Redis cannot keep up.

spec.title: Validations by result (all clients)
spec.description: DNSSEC validation outcomes. A rise in 'bogus' results means responses failed signature validation.

spec.title: Dropped queries by protocol (all clients)
spec.description: Queries rejected by the per-client rate limiter.

spec.title: Active buckets (all clients)
spec.description: Token buckets (≈ distinct clients) currently tracked in memory.

spec.title: Bucket store cap exhausted (all clients)
spec.description: Queries dropped because the bucket store hit its size cap — consider raising the cap if this fires under normal load.

spec.name: client
spec.label: Client
spec.description: Filters Queries by outcome, Query rate by client, Query types, and Response reasons. Top 10 clients and Response codes show all clients. Other sections are unaffected.

spec.name: blocky_url
spec.label: blocky API URL
spec.description: Base URL of the blocky HTTP API, reachable from your browser.
